title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — There Goes the Neighborhood
Welcome to Limon Correctional Facility, a level 4 prison that houses many of Colorado's most dangerous inmates; while visiting Limon Correctional, the Lockup crew is greeted by angry inmates and the cell extraction team is called in to help.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Hurts
Even for inmates serving hard time, love can be a strong motivator; in prison, reaching out to others can be a dicey proposition; some inmates just don't know when someone's getting too close until it's too late.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Cabin Fever
Unlike prison inmates who have already been convicted and sentenced for their crimes, most jail inmates stand charged and are still working their cases through the court system; the process can take years, so some try to make their jail cells home.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Fallen Leaf
An inmate finds himself at the center of more than one battle, and he traces his problems back to the real-life nightmare that haunts his family; a young new arrival faces a charge of reckless homicide.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Enough is Enough
A repeat offender smuggles in contraband and an inmate becomes a marked man after murdering a Louisville rap star; a prescription pill epidemic takes its toll on the jail and drug use on the inside could keep another inmate from leaving.

title: Lockup: Cleveland: Extended Stay
description:
S16 E4 — Rush
In the Cuyahoga Country Correction Center's intake department an out-of-control inmate creates chaos; an inmate who has spent 24 years on Death Row may be facing freedom.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Dead Run
A heroin addict must choose between the lifestyle she craves and the young son she has left behind; another seasoned female inmate is transferred back to the jail from state prison, but she suddenly finds herself on the wrong end of a fist.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — To PC or Not to PC
A celebrity rapper enters the Santa Rita jail, but his arrest leaves a heartbroken girlfriend behind; two brothers deal with gangs, drugs and parenthood and a three-time convicted murderer claims he's killed others as well.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Horribility
An inmate's erratic behavior triggers the emergency response team and mental health staff; a murderer faces the death penalty while his girlfriend awaits trial in the women's wing of the same jail.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — The Force LaForce
A new inmate fears the worst; a gang member asks for help to change his life, but first he must convince a staff member with plenty of his own experience on the inside.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Blue Balloons
A young couple comes to jail after a crime spree, but their stories don't add up; one of the jail's most prolific contraband smugglers makes her return, but staff cracks down on the pipeline.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Fight or Flight
The Penitentiary of New Mexico houses both low level and max-security inmates; Level 6 inmates like Chris Shiverdecker, who has a MacGyver-like prison reputation, are still eligible for hearings that could change custody level and security status.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Mail, Nails, Jail
The jail's Special Operations Group is called in to deal with a difficult inmate; a well-known inmate returns to jail, but this time, he's in with his girlfriend, who might be harboring a secret that could dramatically affect both their lives.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S6 E3 — Rock Bottom
Addiction leads prisoners to serious crime to fuel their habits.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S5 E6 — No Boys Allowed
A look at female inmates that start off socializing, but end up creating a lot drama for the staff.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Hugs Not Drugs
Inmates have been dreaming up new ways to smuggle in contraband since Corcoran opened its doors in 1988; whether in the form of drugs or weapons, it's always a race against time for prison officials to find the banned items before it's too late.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Road to Redemption
Bad decisions have landed thousands of inmates in Corcoran; once in prison, they've got two choices, do their time and go home or become even more destructive on the inside; the path they choose could determine the difference between life and death.
